developer_context.problem_scenario: An API sets HTTP Link headers to support HATEOAS pagination relations.
developer_context.observable_behavior: Attempting to specify multiple URIs with the same relation category overwrites prior entries instead of concatenating them.
developer_context.expected_outcome: Allow multiple Link header entries sharing the same relation attribute to be combined into a comma-separated header.
developer_context.environmental_context: HTTP Link header construction for pagination.
